name: iruma_kalego_familiar
about: Iruma-kun story Short: a human with no magic hopes to fail the familiar ritual and get expelled back home - and summons his strict teacher Kalego as his familiar instead.

story.why: I'm human, so I don't have any magical powers
if they expel me, I'll be scot-free... Hallelujah, back to the human world!
Kalego: me?! A familiar?! Nullify this contract immediately!

outro.why: Suzuki Iruma, age fourteen, acquired a familiar on his first day of school

title: He Tried To FAIL Demon School... And Summoned His Teacher As A Pet
hook: Iruma is a human hiding in demon school. He hoped to fail the summoning ritual and get sent home. Instead he summoned his strictest teacher.
